name: Young's inequality for products
description: For a, b >= 0 and conjugate exponents p, q (1/p + 1/q = 1): ab <= a^p/p + b^q/q, with equality iff a^p = b^q.

name: Conjugate exponents
description: A pair (p, q) with 1 <= p, q <= infinity satisfying 1/p + 1/q = 1, fundamental to Lp space duality and Holder's inequality.

name: Log-convexity of Lp norms (Riesz interpolation inequality)
description: For 1 <= p1 <= p <= p2 <= infinity, if f in Lp1 cap Lp2, then f in Lp and ||f||_p <= ||f||_{p1}^theta ||f||_{p2}^{1-theta} where 1/p = theta/p1 + (1-theta)/p2.

name: Bounded Radon measure
description: A Radon measure mu on X that extends to a continuous linear form on C_0(X), equivalently one with finite total variation |mu|(X) < infinity.

name: Support of a measure
description: The smallest closed set F such that mu(f) = 0 for every continuous function f with compact support contained in X \ F.

name: Total variation measure
description: For a complex Radon measure mu, the positive measure |mu| defined by |mu|(f) = sup{|mu(g)| : |g| <= f, g in K(X)} for f >= 0, making bounded measures a Banach space under ||mu|| = |mu|(X).

name: Vague topology on measures
description: The weak-* topology sigma(M(X), K(X)) on the space of Radon measures, where mu_n -> mu vaguely iff mu_n(f) -> mu(f) for all f in K(X).

name: Dirac measure
description: The measure delta_x defined by delta_x(f) = f(x) for a point x in X, the atomic probability measure concentrated at a single point.

name: Image measure (pushforward measure)
description: For a proper continuous map phi: X -> Y and a measure mu on X, the image measure phi_*(mu) on Y defined by phi_*(mu)(f) = mu(f o phi).

name: Regularity of Radon measures
description: Every Radon measure on a locally compact space is inner regular (approximable from below by compact sets) and outer regular (approximable from above by open sets) on sigma-finite measurable sets.

name: Upper integral
description: For a positive measure mu and a lower semicontinuous function f >= 0, defined as mu*(f) = sup{mu(g) : g in K(X), 0 <= g <= f}, extending integration beyond continuous functions.

name: Measurable function (Bourbaki, mu-measurable)
description: A function f: X -> R is mu-measurable if for every compact K and epsilon > 0, there exists compact K' subset K with mu(K \ K') < epsilon such that f|_{K'} is continuous (Lusin characterization).

name: Integrable function (Lebesgue integrable)
description: A measurable function f is mu-integrable if integral |f| dmu < infinity, where the integral is defined via the Daniell construction extending from continuous functions with compact support.

name: Negligible set (mu-null set)
description: A set N subset X is mu-negligible if mu*(chi_N) = 0, equivalently if it is contained in an open set of arbitrarily small measure.

name: Lp space (1 <= p < infinity)
description: The Banach space of equivalence classes of measurable functions f with integral |f|^p dmu < infinity, modulo equality a.e., with norm ||f||_p = (integral |f|^p dmu)^{1/p}.

name: L-infinity space
description: The Banach space of equivalence classes of essentially bounded measurable functions, with norm ||f||_infinity = ess sup |f| = inf{M : |f| <= M a.e.}.

name: Dense subspaces of Lp
description: For 1 <= p < infinity, the space K(X) of continuous functions with compact support is dense in Lp(mu), as is the space of simple functions.

name: Essential supremum
description: The essential supremum of a measurable function f is ess sup f = inf{M in R : f <= M a.e.}, the smallest a.e. upper bound.

name: Convergence in measure
description: A sequence (f_n) converges to f in measure if for every epsilon > 0, mu({x : |f_n(x) - f(x)| > epsilon}) -> 0; Lp convergence implies convergence in measure.

name: Product measure
description: For sigma-finite measures mu on X and nu on Y, the unique measure mu tensor nu on X x Y satisfying (mu tensor nu)(A x B) = mu(A) nu(B) for measurable rectangles.

name: Tonelli's theorem
description: If f is a non-negative measurable function on X x Y, then integral f d(mu tensor nu) = integral integral f(x,y) dmu(x) dnu(y), with iterated integrals equal without assuming integrability.

name: Change of variables formula (integration on Rn)
description: If phi: U -> V is a C1 diffeomorphism between open sets in Rn, then integral_V f(y) dy = integral_U f(phi(x)) |det J_phi(x)| dx for integrable f.

name: Bochner integral
description: The integral of a strongly measurable function f: X -> E (E a Banach space) with integral ||f|| dmu < infinity, defined as the limit of integrals of simple functions; f is Bochner integrable iff ||f|| is Lebesgue integrable.

name: Strongly measurable function
description: A function f: X -> E (E separable Banach space) is strongly measurable if it is the a.e. limit of a sequence of simple (measurable, finitely-valued) functions.

name: Vector-valued measure (vector measure)
description: A countably additive map mu: Sigma -> E from a sigma-algebra into a Banach space, generalizing scalar measures.

name: Radon-Nikodym derivative (density)
description: The a.e. unique measurable function dnu/dmu satisfying nu(A) = integral_A (dnu/dmu) dmu for all measurable sets A, existing when nu << mu and both are sigma-finite.

name: Left invariance of Haar measure
description: A measure mu on a topological group G is left-invariant if mu(gA) = mu(A) for all g in G and all measurable A, equivalently integral f(g^{-1}x) dmu(x) = integral f(x) dmu(x).

name: Right Haar measure
description: A right-invariant positive Radon measure on G, related to left Haar measure via the modular function: d mu_r(x) = Delta(x^{-1}) d mu_l(x).

name: Modular function
description: The continuous homomorphism Delta: G -> R_+* defined by mu(Ag) = Delta(g) mu(A) for left Haar measure mu, measuring the failure of left Haar measure to be right-invariant.

name: Unimodular group
description: A locally compact group whose modular function is identically 1, so left and right Haar measures coincide; includes all compact groups, abelian groups, and semisimple Lie groups.

name: Haar measure on compact groups
description: On a compact group, the Haar measure is both left- and right-invariant (unimodular) and can be normalized to a probability measure with mu(G) = 1.

name: Integration formula for quotient groups
description: If H is a closed subgroup of G with Haar measures mu_G, mu_H, and G/H admits an invariant measure, then integral_G f dmu_G = integral_{G/H} (integral_H f(xh) dmu_H(h)) dmu_{G/H}(xH).

name: Weil's formula (quotient integral formula)
description: A G-invariant measure on the quotient space G/H exists if and only if Delta_G|_H = Delta_H, and when it exists it is unique up to a positive scalar.

name: Convolution of measures
description: For bounded Radon measures mu and nu on a locally compact group G, the convolution (mu * nu)(f) = integral integral f(xy) dmu(x) dnu(y), making bounded measures a Banach algebra.

name: Convolution of functions on a group
description: For f, g in L1(G), the convolution (f * g)(x) = integral_G f(xy^{-1}) g(y) dmu(y) with respect to left Haar measure, making L1(G) a Banach algebra.

name: Approximate identity in L1(G)
description: A net (e_i) in L1(G) with integral e_i dmu = 1 and support shrinking to {e} such that e_i * f -> f in L1 norm for all f, replacing the absent unit element.

name: Character of a representation
description: The character of a finite-dimensional representation pi is the function chi_pi(g) = tr(pi(g)), a continuous class function that determines the representation up to equivalence.

name: Convolution algebra of measures M(G)
description: The Banach space of bounded Radon measures on G with convolution as multiplication and total variation as norm, forming a unital Banach algebra with unit delta_e.

name: Integrated representation
description: For a unitary representation pi of G on H, the integrated form pi~: L1(G) -> B(H) defined by pi~(f) = integral_G f(g) pi(g) dmu(g) is a non-degenerate *-representation of the group algebra.

name: Fourier transform on locally compact abelian groups
description: For f in L1(G), the Fourier transform f_hat(chi) = integral_G f(g) overline{chi(g)} dmu(g) for chi in G_hat, mapping L1(G) to C_0(G_hat) and satisfying (f * g)^ = f_hat g_hat.

name: Fourier inversion formula (LCA groups)
description: Under appropriate normalization of Haar measures, if f in L1(G) and f_hat in L1(G_hat), then f(g) = integral_{G_hat} f_hat(chi) chi(g) d mu_hat(chi) for a.e. g.

name: Tight measure
description: A Borel measure mu on a topological space X is tight if for every epsilon > 0, there exists a compact set K with mu(X \ K) < epsilon.

name: Weak convergence of measures (narrow convergence)
description: A sequence of measures mu_n converges weakly to mu if integral f dmu_n -> integral f dmu for all bounded continuous functions f.

name: Regular Borel measure
description: A Borel measure that is both inner regular (mu(A) = sup{mu(K) : K subset A compact}) and outer regular (mu(A) = inf{mu(U) : U supset A open}) on all measurable sets.

name: Inner regularity
description: A measure mu is inner regular on a measurable set A if mu(A) = sup{mu(K) : K subset A, K compact}.

name: Outer regularity
description: A measure mu is outer regular on a measurable set A if mu(A) = inf{mu(U) : A subset U, U open}.

name: Suslin space (analytic space)
description: A Hausdorff topological space that is the continuous image of a Polish space; every Borel subset of a Polish space is Suslin, and measures on Suslin spaces have strong regularity properties.

name: Choquet capacitability theorem
description: In a Suslin space, every analytic set is capacitable, meaning its outer measure equals the supremum of measures of compact subsets, extending inner regularity to analytic sets.

name: Daniell integral approach
function_signature: (Positive linear functional on lattice of functions) -> (Complete measure and integration theory)
description: Bourbaki's method of defining integration starting from a positive linear functional on a lattice of functions, then extending via upper integrals and completion, rather than from a measure on sets.

name: Approximation by continuous functions
function_signature: (Measurable or integrable function, epsilon > 0) -> (Continuous function with compact support within epsilon)
description: The systematic use of Urysohn's lemma and partitions of unity to approximate measurable or integrable functions by continuous functions with compact support.

name: Inductive limit topology
description: The finest locally convex topology on K(X) = union_K C(K) making all inclusion maps C(K) -> K(X) continuous, used in Bourbaki's definition of Radon measures.

name: Abel-Liouville formula (Wronskian formula)
description: The Wronskian of solutions of y' = A(t)y satisfies W(t) = W(t_0) exp(integral_{t_0}^t tr A(s) ds), showing it is either identically zero or never zero.

name: Pontryagin dual group
description: For a locally compact abelian group G, the dual group G_hat = Hom(G, T) is the group of continuous homomorphisms from G to the circle group T, equipped with the compact-open topology.

name: Spectral radius formula
description: For a bounded linear operator T on a Banach space, the spectral radius r(T) = lim ||T^n||^{1/n} = inf ||T^n||^{1/n}.

name: Resolvent of an operator
description: For lambda not in sigma(T), the resolvent R(lambda,T) = (lambda I - T)^{-1} is a bounded operator depending analytically on lambda, satisfying the resolvent identity R(lambda) - R(mu) = (mu - lambda)R(lambda)R(mu).

name: Pettis integral (weak integral)
description: A vector x in E is the Pettis integral of f: X -> E if <x, x'> = integral <f, x'> dmu for all x' in E'; weaker than Bochner, requiring only scalar measurability.

name: Convolution semigroup
description: A family (mu_t)_{t>=0} of probability measures on a locally compact group satisfying mu_s * mu_t = mu_{s+t} and mu_0 = delta_e, modeling diffusion and Markov processes on groups.
